note: Language and use-case cells add two sealed supplements (L1: 354 language items, L2: 33 use-case items, drawn 6 Oct 2026, reviewed) to the S 1,200 + P 300 pool, so every language and every use case has at least 30 items. Headline scores, ranks and the Composite are unchanged: they stay on S + P (or the equated API sets). Rows without an entry were not run on the supplements yet and keep their S + P cells.
lane_note: Self-hosted cells and hosted-API cells pool S 1,200 + P 300 plus the sealed supplements L1 354 + L2 33 (1,887 items) where a row answered them; raw and unequated. Cells under 15 items are omitted.
labelling: Family and language are authoring metadata of every item. Each of the 1,500 v1.6 items and each of the 387 supplement items (L1 language supplement 354, L2 use-case supplement 33) was labelled with one subject topic (the v1.2 topic list, unchanged) and one TypeSafe use-case category by Winnow-12B Q8 on our own GPU pod, with the same model, questions, taxonomy and item-group rules (labelling rounds r13 and r14); where a uc1 item was written for a use case, that authoring use case is used instead. Sealed items stayed on our own infrastructure. 75 public items (5 %) of the main pool were checked by hand (topic agreement before rules 93 %). All non-English uc1 items are machine-authored and not native-reviewed. Self-hosted systems and full-set hosted APIs answered S u P (1,500 items) plus the supplements where their row is tagged so; API rows re-run on A4/A5 have no cells yet.
rules: Cells with fewer than 15 items are omitted; categories under 30 items are marked low-n.
Core v1.6 items carry no use case; the use-case view covers the use-case (uc1) items of S u P and the L2 supplement.

families.label: LLM routing
families.covers: pick the model, tier or agent that should handle a request (TypeSafe LLM Auto Router focus)

families.label: Multilingual
families.covers: the same kind of decision asked in 21 languages besides English

families.label: Fairness
families.covers: decisions whose answer must not change with a protected attribute

families.label: Use-case decisions
families.covers: single decisions from the TypeSafe use-case map outside routing

families.label: Jaggedness
families.covers: easy-looking items from areas where models fail unevenly

families.label: Negation consistency
families.covers: pairs where a negation must flip the answer

families.label: Option-order robustness
families.covers: the same question with shuffled answer options

families.label: Perturbation consistency
families.covers: pairs that differ in an irrelevant detail and must get the same answer

families.label: Composite rules
families.covers: several conditions that must all be checked before deciding

families.label: Calibration (generated)
families.covers: generated items that test confidence against outcome rates

families.label: Long state
families.covers: decisions that depend on a long input state

families.label: Calibration (fixed)
families.covers: items with known answer frequencies that test the reported confidence

usecases.label: Model routing
usecases.covers: deciding which LLM or model tier should handle a prompt; classifying a request's intent, domain, difficulty or risk to pick a model

usecases.label: Legal and compliance
usecases.covers: contracts, policies, regulations, eligibility rules, checking documents against written requirements

usecases.label: Customer support
usecases.covers: classifying tickets and customer intents, urgency, refunds, routing cases to a team, checking support replies

usecases.label: Other
usecases.covers: none of the above: general reasoning, arithmetic or date puzzles, everyday assistant requests without a business workflow

usecases.label: E-commerce marketplaces
usecases.covers: product listings, product attributes, orders and deliveries, seller catalog policy

usecases.label: Insurance claims
usecases.covers: first-notice-of-loss reports, claim complexity, missing information, claim triage

usecases.label: Risk assessment
usecases.covers: estimating probabilities and severity of risks, incidents, vendor or underwriting risk

usecases.label: Financial crime
usecases.covers: suspicious transactions, KYC, fraud alerts, entity matching for investigations

usecases.label: Moderation and trust and safety
usecases.covers: user content moderation: toxicity, harassment, spam, unsafe advice, personal data exposure

usecases.label: Semantic code linting
usecases.covers: checking code or writing against conventions and guidelines, as in CI review of code

usecases.label: Lead generation
usecases.covers: matching companies or inbound messages to an ideal customer profile, buyer intent, prioritising and routing sales leads

usecases.label: Feature extraction for predictive modeling
usecases.covers: turning natural-language data into probabilistic features or estimates for a downstream prediction

usecases.label: LLM guardrails
usecases.covers: checking LLM inputs, outputs and tool calls: prompt injection, jailbreaks, policy violations, tool-call errors, answer quality

usecases.label: Search and retrieval
usecases.covers: scoring query-to-candidate relevance, reranking results, selecting useful context for RAG

usecases.label: Advertising
usecases.covers: ad creatives, campaign copy, brand safety, prohibited claims in ads

usecases.label: Demand forecasting
usecases.covers: purchase intent, product interest, demand and supply signals for forecasting

usecases.label: Recruiting
usecases.covers: resumes, applications, interview feedback, matching candidates to roles

usecases.label: Graphs and knowledge graphs
usecases.covers: entity types, relationships between records, contradictions between facts, multi-step lookups across linked facts

usecases.label: Gaming
usecases.covers: player reports, in-game chat, game support

usecases.label: Scientific discovery
usecases.covers: screening papers, labelling research passages or survey answers, checking that citations support claims, methodology checks
